_about: The international tournaments golboard's API serves, beside the club leagues in leagues.json. Each is played in groups; its games come from the English Wikipedia group pages ("<wikipedia> A" to "<wikipedia> L"), whose match boxes give the date, the local kick-off with its UTC offset, and the score. qualify: how many from each group go through. hosts: nations already in the finals as hosts, by FIFA code; a host's group sends the host plus the best of the rest. tiebreak: as in leagues.json, plus h2h_away_gf (CAF regulations, Article 14). A head-to-head rule always counts only the games among the teams still level at that point, so a smaller set left level is split by its own games.
